parties: MPS Limited (debtor company); Unsecured Creditors' Committee
headline: MPS Limited NCLT-convened Unsecured Creditors Meeting Held; Voting Results Filed
sum: MPS Limited convened an NCLT-ordered meeting of unsecured creditors on 22 August 2026, with voting results and scrutinizer's report filed to NSE. The filing indicates progression through the insolvency resolution process under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016.
implication: Unsecured creditor approval in NCLT insolvency proceedings is a critical gate to resolution plan confirmation; the voting results here determine whether a resolution plan has creditor backing and moves toward NCLT approval and implementation, or whether liquidation becomes the default path.
detail: MPS Limited held an NCLT-convened meeting of its unsecured creditors on Saturday, 22 August 2026, as part of its formal insolvency resolution process. The company filed the Voting Results and Scrutinizer's Report with the National Stock Exchange on the same day, satisfying disclosure obligations. The nature and outcome of the voting (whether approval or rejection of a resolution plan) was not disclosed in the NSE filing abstract, but the filing confirms procedural compliance with NCLT directions and suggests the insolvency process has progressed to the creditor voting stage.

framework.note: Mandatory convening of creditors' committee and creditors' meetings to evaluate and vote on resolution plans; unsecured creditors vote separately from secured creditors.
Admission of insolvency application and commencement of corporate insolvency resolution process (CIRP).
Voting procedure and approval threshold (majority by value and number) required for resolution plan to be deemed approved.
NCLT approval of resolution plan after creditors vote; NCLT may reject if plan violates statutory requirements or public interest.

framework.note: Conduct of creditors' meetings, voting procedures, and preparation of scrutinizer's report.

Related provisions on regulatory scrutiny of insolvency proceedings and shareholder/creditor protections.

conditions: Formation and approval by creditors' committee (prior)
Unsecured creditors vote on resolution plan (this meeting, 22 Aug 2026)
Voting threshold under IBC § 33 (majority in value and number)
approvals: NCLT order convening the unsecured creditors' meeting
Unsecured creditors' approval of resolution plan (subject to voting outcome)
NCLT approval of resolution plan (post-voting, if creditors approve)
structure.novel: Filing of Voting Results and Scrutinizer's Report as a formal NSE disclosure indicates the company is maintaining exchange compliance during insolvency; this is standard procedure under SEBI Listing Regulations for listed companies in NCLT resolution.

triggers.note: NCLT jurisdiction to admit insolvency, direct formation of creditors' committee, convene meetings, and approve resolution plan.
Procedural requirements for voting, scrutinizer's report, and creditor communication.
NSE/BSE disclosure of material events related to insolvency; voting results are material for shareholders and creditors.
